## Summary

Describe the problem solved or enhancement added.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors (`strict: true`)
- [ ] `npm run build` completes cleanly and emits expected types in `dist/`
- [ ] `npm test` passes completely, including Astro SSG E2E coverage
- [ ] Search and citation crawlers (`Googlebot`, `Bingbot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`) remain unaffected unless they violate `robots.txt`
- [ ] No raw client IP addresses, hardcoded site URLs, or secrets are stored or logged
- [ ] Public documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`) matches the implementation
